parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source metabolism table. Join compound_structures on metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_structures.molregno to obtain canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.molregno to obtain substrate_compound_name. Join compound_records on metabolism.drug_record_id = compound_records.molregno to obtain parent_compound_name. Filter organism column for value 'Canis lupus familiaris'. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name in ascending order. Limit output to 200 rows.
